summary: Text-to-image reference retrieval pipeline is functional. Voice input deferred. Indexing quality is acceptable but not perfect.

displays.DP-3: 3328x1872 — XP-Pen drawing display (primary, images open here)

model.name: bartowski/qwen2-vl-2b-instruct
model.json_reliability: Unreliable — hallucinates, outputs dicts instead of strings, copies examples

index_status.approach: Multi-lens (3 captions per image), single API call, auto-resize

input.voice: Not implemented — no mic, Bluetooth dead, Vosk model downloaded but unused

viewer.mode: One window per image, tiled horizontally

working_commands.find_lm_studio: Auto-detected on first run, saved to ~/friday/api_endpoint.txt

scripts: friday_text.py — Main pipeline (text input, auto-detect API, XP-Pen viewer)
search_friday.py — Keyword search on multi-lens index
reindex_all.py — Full re-indexer (minimal prompt, generic example)
listen.py — Vosk voice input (unused, no mic)

what_works_now: Type any word → search captions → open matching images on XP-Pen
Auto-detects LM Studio IP after reboot
Whole-word search finds exact matches (warrior, combat, sword, training, samurai)
5/20 images have acceptable but generic captions
3/20 images have broken/empty captions from JSON parse failures
what_is_broken: Qwen2 VL 2B cannot reliably output structured JSON — hallucinates, nests dicts, copies examples
Voice input not implemented (no mic, Bluetooth dead)
Search misses partial matches (no substring fallback)
No semantic/similarity search — only exact keyword matching
rejected_ideas: CLIP embeddings — user rejected, wants LLM-only
Concurrent indexing — VRAM crash on Arc A750, single-thread only
PyQt6 GUI — too heavy for MVP

tier_1_fixes: Fix 3 broken image captions (manual edit or plain-text re-index)
Add substring fallback to search (so 'war' finds 'warrior')
Test with random words: tree, blue, angry, city, alone, fire
tier_2_features: Targeted domain re-indexing for specific image sets
LLM query expansion with deterministic caching
Search by specific lens: --lens narrative 'tense scene'
tier_3_future: Larger VL model (7B+) for reliable JSON
Batch overnight indexing for new folders

mvp_status: FUNCTIONAL — Text input works, images open on correct monitor, search finds relevant results for 60% of queries. Voice deferred. Quality acceptable for daily use.
